developing a weakly supervised multi organ, multi class classification method for CT scans using only case level disease labels extracted from radiology reports.
the development of a multi-organ, multi-label classification algorithm for computed-tomography (CT) volumes.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we designed and implemented a weakly supervised multi organ multi disease classification algorithm for body CT scans that uses case level labels from the radiology reports.
we created an algorithm to extract labels from radiology texts for multi label disease classification of body CT scans.

we developed an algorithm that can automatically extract labels from text reports of medical images and then use the labels to train a deep learning classifier that can classify the same images into different disease categories.
The main takeaway from our work is that
weakly supervised learning can be a powerful tool for training deep learning models for medical image analysis.
the weak supervision from the radiology reports can be used to train a multi label multi organ classifier for body CT scans.
weakly supervised methods can be used to create classifiers for medical images that are as accurate as supervised classifiers.
